note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Every amount is a fictional figure shown as supplied; the difference between the reference scenario and the alleged loss is only a supplied, stated difference — never computed, valued or decided. No damages, compensation, liability, fault or causation conclusion is drawn. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; subject floor: 'Subject ≥ 0.20 of the frame height at rest and hold (causation-05 LAW-0700 decision)', production/SESSION_HANDOFF.md). True driver: the 1:1 box. After trying the fallback layouts (machine beside the record; the band in the record's column; the band split between the record column and the foot; record over band under the machine; record and band side by side under the machine, 'below2'), the full stress counts (five entries, two alternatives, two labelled links, two stated items, two notes) did not fit 1:1 without the fallback scale. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-09-27): full counts → 1:1 fallback scale k 0.833, smallest text 14.2 px, machine 0.076 of the frame height; 16:9 20.0 px / 0.432; 9:16 20.0 px / 0.254. The stress keeps every text at its near-maximum length and caps the COUNTS at five entries, one alternative, one labelled link, one stated item and one note (baseline 3 / 0 / 0 / 1 / 1); after the cap: 1:1 17.0 px / 0.241 without scaling; 16:9 22.0 px / 0.458; 9:16 22.0 px / 0.279. Every field stays longer than the baseline and every count ≥ the baseline.
